text:
marie (Partnerships): Hey team — final NovaEdge case story + one-pager uploaded to Figma. Need quick pass on logo spacing, localized CTA copy, and alt text. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/NovaEdge-Case-Story
leo (Design): Looking now. Noticed NovaEdge logo sits too close to Redwood lockup on the hero — need 16px min clearspace per brand guidelines.
sam (PMM): Agreed. Also CTA variants: 'Get started' vs 'Try NovaEdge' — which should we use for marketplace listing?
marie (Partnerships): Marketplace wants vendor-forward CTAs — prefer 'Try NovaEdge' for the tile, but keep 'Get started' on our landing for consistency.
jin (Localization): For localized CTAs, do we want literal translations or transcreation? Chinese and Japanese markets prefer shorter action words.
nana (Legal): @ana (Legal) here — check on third-party logo usage: we need a signed logo usage addendum from NovaEdge before public assets go live. Can we get that before the publish?
nana (typo correction)
nana -> ana (Legal): sorry, meant @ana.
nana (this message is not part of thread)
leo (Design): Updated the Figma with 16px clearspace token and alt text fields. Also added a smaller badge variant (44px) for marketplace thumbnails.
marie (Partnerships): Nice. Can you add an example of the thumbnail in-context with the marketplace tile? They have a 300x200 hero crop.
leo (Design): Done — see frame 'Marketplace-tile-300x200'. Thumbnail scales fine but the badge loses legibility at 44px; recommending 56px for hero tile.
sam (PMM): Noted. For messaging, here's proposed copy: 'NovaEdge + Redwood: low-latency inference on certified hardware. Try NovaEdge.' Thoughts?
jin (Localization): For Spanish and Portuguese, 'Prueba NovaEdge' is fine. For German maybe 'Jetzt testen' sounds more CTA-y. I'll prepare variants.
nana -> ana (Legal): We need to replace any customer logos in the case story with placeholders until we have explicit permission. Also confirm there are no specific product claims that require substantiation.
marie (Partnerships): Good catch. There are a couple quantitative claims ("2x throughput"). Sam, can you point to the benchmark doc or tone down?
sam (PMM): I'll link benchmark notes. For the public one-pager, let's change to 'up to 2x throughput in internal benchmarks' and add a footnote pointing to our eval repo.
asset-bot: Reminder — asset checklist incomplete: missing logo addendum, alt text finalization, and localized CTA file. Due: 3 business days.
marie (Partnerships): Thanks. Action items: 1) @leo update badge to 56px for marketplace hero, 2) @ana request logo usage addendum and confirm product claim language, 3) @jin localize CTAs and supply strings, 4) @sam add benchmark link or adjust claim. I'll follow up with NovaEdge PM for sign-off.
nana (typo again)
marie (Partnerships): Haha, ignore previous typos. One more ask: add 2 alt text options per image (short + descriptive) in Figma alt-layer. That helps accessibility reviewers.
leo (Design): Will add alt short/descriptive layers before EOD.
nana (this final typo message again)
